title: Bad service
body: I downloaded this app to try and see the usefulness of it. Thus I applied for the test period. After the test period I didn’t find any place that says that I have an active subscription so I though all is good and I deleted the app. After I had deducted money for the whole year! I downloaded the app again, I didn’t even have an active profile but no money was returned, there was no active subscription, and they weren’t even sorry. No support.
author: manamega
